name: rad-brainstorm
description: An Agent Plugins 1.0.0 package for solo, text-first brainstorming in Codex. It separates idea generation from evaluation, but it cannot guarantee useful ideas or correct conclusions.

interface.shortDescription: Solo, text-first brainstorming with clear limits.
interface.longDescription: RAD Brainstorm is an Agent Plugins 1.0.0 package with Codex marketplace metadata for one-person, text-first idea work. It asks for the user's ideas first, labels sources, separates generation from evaluation, and supports brainstorming, Five Whys, idea comparison, and software design. It cannot guarantee original ideas or correct causal claims, and it stops before implementation.
defaultPrompt: Run a quick brainstorm on this topic.
Help me explore this idea without anchoring me on your answers.
Use Five Whys to find the root cause of this problem.
Help me compare these ideas before I choose one.
Turn this chosen software idea into a reviewable design spec.
